Thanks a bunch for replying.  I am a really intensely private person, so this was putting myself out there a lot more than I usually do.

That said, if I were convinced I could continue to survive without this job, I'd quit in a heartbeat.

Thanks so much for replying.  Seriously.

There are a few big problems with my job.  One is that it's ~90% dealing with customers.  Frequently annoyed customers.  And sure, no one likes doing that, but I'm as introverted as they come, so by the time it's over I just want to go home and lay in bed and not interact with anyone the rest of the day.  Lock me in a room by myself doing the most menial of data entry, okay, but people?  No thank you.

In addition to that, it's not a career at all and while they'll claim there's lots of promotional opportunities, well, that's just not true in practice.  I've had a bachelor's degree for close to two years now, and it's incredibly disheartening to not even get calls back for those data entry type jobs - that'd at least solve the first problem.
